column2: # Generate the power spectra for age groups
ggplot(aes(x = frequency, y = mean_power, group = channel)) +
labs(x = "Frequency (Hz)", y = "log(Power)", title = "Avg. Power Spectra For All Channels\nBetween Age Groups") +
# Generate the relative power spectra for age groups
ggplot(aes(x = frequency, y = mean_power, group = channel)) +
labs(x = "Frequency (Hz)", y = "logit(Relative\nPower)", title = "Avg. Relative Power Spectra For All Channels\nBetween Age Groups") +
